comments.body: This seems a bit "draw the rest of the owl". Not today's problem, but... I wonder if we can produce this information a bit more realistically.

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body: What does this mean? We don't "use extend", we use `+`.
comments.label_reasoning: The comment points out that the documentation/description is misleading — it references 'extend' but the code actually uses '+', indicating a mismatch between the description and the code.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Points out a confusing or incorrect statement in the documentation ('What does this mean?') and notes a discrepancy with actual usage, implying the text should be corrected.
